name: @plexo/research-agent
description: Deep research with source gathering and cited summaries. Reference implementation of a Plexo PEX Agent.
author: Plexo

capabilitiesRationale.memory:read:thread: Reads the conversation thread to understand what the user is researching and pick up on follow-up questions.
capabilitiesRationale.memory:write:note: Saves the cited research summary back to your workspace as a note so you can reference it later.
capabilitiesRationale.ui:notify: Posts the 'research complete' status update into the active chat when the report is ready.
